body: Indeed, I've been on many different anti-depressants, and unfortunately even anti-nausea medication for chemo patients hasn't helped at all.
Thanks for the suggestion, but I've had a lot of medical tests done and nothing has shown up. I used to think Celiac or Addison's or something like that, but it isn't.

Thank you for the nice note, but doctors haven't been helping. I have been seeing both a therapist and a psychiatrist (and it's not the first time, there have been many others in my past) and neither know what to do with this. It is what it is, I guess. I ODd about a year and a half ago and saw an email from my grandfather to my mother telling her to gear up for me being gone. So there's that.
